label: 记忆目录
name: memory
description: Persistent memory directory for this user. Files under /memories/ carry over between separate conversations and are the only record of what was established in earlier sessions — none of it is present in the current context. Read the relevant file before the first substantive reply of a conversation, and treat what it returns as already-confirmed fact about this user, not as a suggestion to consider.
fallbackResult: No file at that path. The memory directory is empty — this is the first recorded conversation with this user.

label: 列出记忆文件（可选）
name: list_memories
description: List the files currently stored in the persistent memory directory, with size and last-modified time. Call this first when you do not already know which memory files exist for this user.
